newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 76,800 MT were two and one-fifth times the prior week and two-thirds above the 4-week average. The major buyers were Japan (54,600 MT) and Israel (12,000 MT).
Exports of 79,000 MT were down 9 percent from the previous week and 26 percent below the 4-week average. Mexico (54,800 MT) and Japan (15,800 MT) were the primary destinations.
